item.title: Why are dead bumblebees appearing on sidewalks?
item.description: Bumblebees have short natural lifespans, but extreme heat and human activity worsen survival. Pesticides can poison bees or destroy flowers.

item.title: Microwave frying method could make french fries healthier
item.description: A new cooking technique could produce crispier french fries faster while reducing oil absorption. Researchers suggest combining microwaves with frying.

item.title: Can't sleep in the heat? These 8 tricks could save your night
item.description: Sleeping well during a heatwave starts with preventing the home from overheating. Close blinds against strong sunlight and ventilate when the air outside is cooler.

item.title: A tiny molecular basket unlocks a powerful new kind of chemistry
